source.title: Open Interest 11/11/2026
source.description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." CoreWeave’s upbeat forecast reignites the tech trade, while Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO adds fresh fuel to AI optimism. Fed hike bets build after Austan Goolsbee sounds the alarm on inflation. Plus, Terry Haines joins us on the fallout from Nvidia’s scandal, and Ann Berry and Victoria Fernandez weigh in on  the market setup.
